AppFunctionAppMetadata.app:instructions: Answers questions about the one event the user has joined in Attnd (a festival, conference or similar), from the copy stored on the phone. Works offline. Operational patterns: - Use 'getHappeningNow' for what is on now or soon, 'findScheduleItems' for when something happens, 'findLocations' for where a place is, 'getLatestUpdates' for organizer announcements, 'getEventInfo' for dates and address, and 'searchEvent' for anything else. - Times are in the event's own time zone; startTime and endTime carry its UTC offset. - Offer to open a result with its 'openInApp' intent. Constraints: - Only one event at a time. If no event is joined, ask the user to open Attnd and join one.
